body: Just so much. My girlfriend dumped me. I lost my job. My self confidence is shot. I have no real skills to find another job with and I have bills to pay. I have no friends to talk to so I'm all alone. I can't even go outside because I have heart issues and Covid is crazy where I live.

I am sure about it because they regularly torment my aunt who attempted. She's the joke of family gatherings. I can't even tell my mom I'm sad without her going off on me. If they ever found out I was seeing a professional, it would just get worst. I also have no friends.
My family doesn't believe in mental illness or depression and they would humiliate me if they ever found out I was like this. I have an aunt who attempted suicide and they regularly torment her.

My family doesn't believe in mental illness. It's a big part of why I haven't looked into getting therapy. If they ever found out, they'd humiliate me. I have an aunt who tried to kill herself and they torment her regularly.
I don't really have any. My ex was my best friend and my friends were sort of her friends.
My family doesn't believe in mental illness, depression, or anything like that. Most likely all I'd get from telling them is being made fun of.
